rule_description: Required stairways are generally at least 44 inches wide.

rule_name: Stair minimum width for occupant load under 50
rule_description: Stairways serving an occupant load less than 50 may be at least 36 inches wide.
applies_when: Stair occupant load <50.
ai_check_method: If occupant load <50, compare clear width to 36 in.

rule_description: Typical egress stair riser height is limited to 7 inches maximum.
applies_when: Standard egress stair; exceptions may apply.
ai_check_method: Compare proposed riser to 7 in.
implementation_notes: Verify final source/exceptions before production use.

rule_description: Typical rectangular egress stair tread depth is 11 inches minimum.
applies_when: Standard egress stair; exceptions may apply.
ai_check_method: Compare proposed tread depth to 11 in.
implementation_notes: Verify final source/exceptions before production use.

rule_description: Corridors not otherwise listed in the table are generally at least 44 inches wide.
applies_when: Typical hotel corridor unless another condition is more restrictive.
ai_check_method: Compare corridor clear width to 44 in and capacity requirement.
notes: Hotel planning may intentionally use wider corridors; that belongs in the planning-rule database, not the IBC database.

rule_name: Minimum corridor width when occupant load is under 50
rule_description: A corridor serving an occupant load less than 50 may be 36 inches minimum where no more restrictive provision applies.
applies_when: Occupant load served <50 and no other table condition controls.
ai_check_method: Calculate corridor occupant load then compare width.

rule_name: Dead-end corridor maximum for sprinklered R-1
rule_description: In a fully sprinklered Group R-1 building, dead-end corridors are generally limited to 50 feet.
applies_when: More than one exit required; R-1; NFPA 13.
ai_check_method: Measure dead-end corridor length to decision point.

rule_name: Minimum clear width of required egress door opening
rule_description: Required egress door openings generally provide at least 32 inches of clear width.
applies_when: Required means-of-egress door; exceptions may apply.
ai_check_method: Compare clear opening to 32 in.

rule_description: Means of egress generally has a minimum ceiling height of 7 feet 6 inches.
applies_when: Means-of-egress path; listed exceptions may apply.
ai_check_method: Compare clear ceiling height along egress path to 7.5 ft.
implementation_notes: Verify listed exceptions before production use.

rule_description: For areas without fixed seating, occupant load is determined by dividing the applicable floor area by the occupant-load factor for the function of the space.
applies_when: Area without fixed seating with a listed Table 1004.5 function.
ai_check_method: Divide applicable floor area by factor and round up to the next whole occupant.
notes: Space-function mapping must be established first.
implementation_notes: Core formula consumed by factor rows.

rule_description: Concentrated assembly without fixed seats uses 7 net square feet per occupant.
applies_when: Chairs-only or similarly concentrated assembly arrangement.
ai_check_method: Divide net area by 7 and round up.
notes: Use only when actual layout/function is concentrated assembly.

rule_description: Standing assembly space uses 5 net square feet per occupant.
applies_when: Standing-room or queuing-style assembly use.
ai_check_method: Divide net area by 5 and round up.
notes: Apply only to actual standing-use layout.

rule_description: Unconcentrated assembly with tables and chairs uses 15 net square feet per occupant.
applies_when: Dining, meeting, lounge, or similar table/chair arrangement.
ai_check_method: Divide net area by 15 and round up.
notes: Lobby/lounge mapping remains provisional until actual use/furniture is known.

rule_description: Business areas use 150 gross square feet per occupant.
applies_when: Office, administrative, or similar business area.
ai_check_method: Divide gross area by 150 and round up.

rule_description: Exercise rooms use 50 gross square feet per occupant.
applies_when: Hotel gym or fitness room.
ai_check_method: Divide gross area by 50 and round up.

rule_description: Commercial kitchens use 200 gross square feet per occupant.
applies_when: Commercial hotel kitchen or food-prep area.
ai_check_method: Divide gross area by 200 and round up.
notes: Pantry-only portions may need separate judgment.

rule_description: Accessory storage areas and mechanical equipment rooms use 300 gross square feet per occupant.
applies_when: MEP service, storage, supplies, janitor, and similar accessory areas as appropriate.
ai_check_method: Divide gross area by 300 and round up.
notes: Specific room use should be confirmed before mapping.

rule_description: Mercantile areas use 60 gross square feet per occupant.
applies_when: Retail/sales area.
ai_check_method: Divide gross area by 60 and round up.
implementation_notes: Direct white-box retail mapping when occupied as retail.

rule_description: Mercantile storage, stock, and shipping areas use 300 gross square feet per occupant.
applies_when: Retail stock/support area.
ai_check_method: Divide gross area by 300 and round up.
implementation_notes: Use for retail support, not sales floor.

rule_description: Parking garages use 200 gross square feet per occupant.
applies_when: Structured parking or garage area.
ai_check_method: Divide gross area by 200 and round up.
implementation_notes: Only if prototype includes structured parking.

rule_description: Residential areas use 200 gross square feet per occupant.
applies_when: Hotel guestroom/lodging areas when mapped to the residential Table 1004.5 function.
ai_check_method: Divide gross area by 200 and round up.
notes: Project may separately track keys and room types.

rule_description: Rink and pool areas use 50 gross square feet per occupant.
applies_when: Hotel pool area if included.
ai_check_method: Divide gross area by 50 and round up.

rule_description: Pool and rink decks use 15 gross square feet per occupant.
applies_when: Hotel pool deck if included.
ai_check_method: Divide gross area by 15 and round up.
